description: Task-family equivalence test: SST-2 vs IMDB sentiment on DistilBERT. Tests whether Gradience's strict task-identity boundary is correct or too conservative for practically similar tasks within the same sentiment family.
campaign_question: Is exact task identity too strict for practically similar sentiment tasks?

adapters.notes: SST-2 binary sentiment. Standard q_lin+v_lin LoRA.
SST-2 binary sentiment. Same config as myselfmankar. Provides exact same-task pair.
IMDB binary sentiment. Same target modules as SST-2 adapters. Primary cross-dataset test partner.
IMDB binary sentiment. All-module LoRA (8 targets). Tests cross-dataset with structural mismatch.
IMDB binary sentiment. Q-only LoRA (single target module). Trained on 1k samples — may be weaker.

exact_same_task.description: SST-2 x SST-2 — baseline for retained same-task pairs

same_family_cross_dataset.description: SST-2 x IMDB — the key test. Same sentiment family, different dataset. Does this behave like retained or like cross-task?

cross_task_control.description: Sentiment x non-sentiment — anchor from Phase 2 data. Reuse existing cross-task control scores if backbones match.
cross_task_control.notes: Use inventory_01/02 cross-task data from Phase 2 (sentiment x emotion/ag_news) as control comparison.

selection_rationale: 5 adapters on distilbert-base-uncased: 2 SST-2 + 3 IMDB. Generates 10 pairs total. 1 exact same-task pair (SST-2 x SST-2), 6 same-family cross-dataset pairs (SST-2 x IMDB), 3 same-dataset pairs (IMDB x IMDB). No Yelp/Amazon DistilBERT LoRA adapters available on Hub. SST-2 vs IMDB is the strongest available test of task-family equivalence.

expected_gradience_behavior.task_boundary: Gradience should flag SST-2 x IMDB as cross-task (different eval_dataset strings). The question is whether this advisory is too conservative.
expected_gradience_behavior.structural_compatibility: myselfmankar x dipanjanS should be structurally compatible (same target_modules). muneeb-ai has a wider module set — may show structural mismatch.
expected_gradience_behavior.evidence_gate: All adapters expected to pass evidence bootstrap as eligible or uncertain.
